target_customer: Real estate agents, brokerages, photographers and home stagers who need staged listing photos
problem: Photos of vacant or outdated rooms make listings harder to sell, and traditional virtual staging is slow and manual. Apply Design generates furnished, photorealistic listing images with AI.
business_model: Per image fee (site lists about $10.50 per image for full staging and $7 for DIY)
product_category: AI virtual staging for real estate

founders.name: Asaf Amit
prior_employers: IDF intelligence unit specializing in 3D solutions (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he and Knoll met in the IDF and built 3D and computer vision solutions for about 10 years for military, HR, construction and real estate clients. Education not found.

founders.name: Yaniv Knoll
prior_employers: IDF intelligence unit specializing in 3D solutions (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Same background as Amit per YC page. Education not found.

competitors.name: Zillow
competitors.what: Standard online property listings that the YC launch post positions Apply Design's personalized listings against

competitors.name: Online real estate marketing agencies
competitors.what: Manual, labor-based marketing and staging service providers that Calcalist names as the main competition
competitors.traction_then: Average annual revenue in the tens of millions per Calcalist

technical_complexity.rationale: Founders had a decade of 3D and computer vision work. Photorealistic staging with furniture removal and control was hard in 2022 but built on available generative and vision models.

defensibility.rationale: Generative image tools were spreading fast in 2022 to 2023, so a staging feature was easy to copy. Furniture catalog and agent relationships offer modest stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zillow bought a different AI staging company, Virtual Staging AI, per Zillow Group's news page (date not confirmed here). No incumbent action against Apply Design found.

market_need_then: Agents spent on staging and photo editing to sell vacant listings faster. YC page cites 50M properties sold or rented yearly in North America and Europe, a company claim.

branding.domain_note: Uses applydesign.io, not a .com, as the main domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Product and results focused marketing copy with money back guarantee

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself found. Generic name shared with unrelated design agencies, and review sites list it among many staging tools.

outcome_analysis: Apply Design is active and sells AI virtual staging to agents. It raised a reported $3.3M seed in late 2022 and claims more than 10,000 properties staged monthly. Generative AI made the technology easier for rivals to copy, so growth depends on distribution and quality rather than a deep moat. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff reports were found.
notes: Seed amount of $3.3M and November 2022 date are stated by Calcalist and a search summary of aggregator profiles; CB Insights total of $3.8M, PitchBook $2.15M and another $3.35M figure conflict. Founding year: YC says 2021, aggregators say 2018. Company site names BoxBrownie, VirtualStaging.com, PhotoUp and REimagineHome as rivals, but no source dated near the batch was found, so they are not listed as competitors at founding. Education of founders not found. Exit none inferred from no reports and YC Active status.
